events.author: Minutes
events.text:
2025-11-08: Committee meeting

Present: Arun, Priya, Kavya, Divya, Rohan, Karthik
Absent: none

Discussion

The committee reviewed the plan for the November workshop on IoT basics. The workshop needs the IoT lab, and the lab is booked through the HoD's office.

Decisions

- Workshop on 29 November in the IoT lab.
- A signed HoD permission letter is required before every lab booking, every semester.
- Budget of ₹8,000 approved.

events.author: Minutes
events.text:
2026-01-10: Committee meeting

Present: Priya, Arun, Kavya, Divya, Rohan
Absent: none

Decisions

- Auditorium booking for IoT Fest needs the Dean's office approval, requested a month ahead.
- IoT Fest will be on 14 Feb 2026, as last year.

Finance

- The fest budget is ₹45,000 including sponsorship.

events.author: Minutes
events.text:
2026-03-07: Committee meeting

Present: Priya, Arun, Kavya, Divya
Absent: Rohan

Finance

- Speaker travel of ₹2,400 to Mr. Ganesan will be reimbursed after he submits bills.
- Fest expenses came to ₹41,300 against the ₹45,000 budget.

Actions

- Divya to reimburse Mr. Ganesan once the bills arrive.

Present: Priya, Arun, Kavya, Divya, Rohan
